A01.name: Remove all yield curve features
A01.rationale: Baseline experiments exist without YC features

A02.name: Randomly permute yield curve features
A02.rationale: Permutation test would show no signal; YC features are used as-is

A03.name: Shift features backward
A03.rationale: Features use current values only, no look-ahead

A04.name: Inject future information
A04.rationale: No future information injected; labels are forward returns, features are current

A05.name: Break timestamp alignment
A05.rationale: Features aligned to same timestamps as labels

A08.name: Substitute random noise features
A08.rationale: Noise features would show no predictive power

A14.name: Reverse ranking
A14.rationale: Spearman IC is rank-based; reversal testable

A15.name: Shuffle instrument identities
A15.rationale: Experiments run per-instrument; shuffling would destroy signal

A16.name: Attempt access to quarantined OOS targets
A16.rationale: No OOS data accessed; only in-sample used

A17.name: Attempt experiment-budget bypass
A17.rationale: Budget capped at 20; no bypass attempted
